data.assessment: Under busy-plus-rush demand the town delivered 263.4 of 274.6 orders on time, with no unfinished orders and 11.2 late deliveries. A is now the worst company at 0.91 on-time: it never waits on the road, yet it was blocked for 938 s, the most of any company. C parks on the road, is never late and carries almost all sanctions (14.2). Of the 34.0 violations, the largest cause is release-deadline overstays (19.4), with blocking_guard evictions at 3.4. So parked robots blocking A is the main remaining source of lateness and of the fairness gap.

proposals.title: hold_limit 50s -> 40s
proposals.rationale: A is worst at 0.91 on-time and lost 938 s to blocking. The previous hold_limit step (60 -> 50) passed with A and B voting yes and raised on-time by +2.2 and the lowest company rate from 0.93 to 0.95. One more step should cut further the time parked robots occupy intersections, so on-time and A's rate should rise and late deliveries fall. A and probably B should vote yes, C probably no; release-deadline violations and sanction_total will likely rise, and both will be reported.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 40s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 3 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
assumptions: Shorter allowed parking time reduces how long parked robots block A, as the 60 -> 50 step did.
40 s still leaves enough time to load and unload (constitution minimum is 10 s).
unknowns: Whether gains diminish at 40 s or extra repositioning trips start to cost B and C deliveries under rush load.
How much sanction_total rises from extra release-deadline overstays.

predictions.note: Less intersection blocking should yield a small gain, likely +1 to +3.

predictions.note: Fewer late pickups caused by blocking.

predictions.note: More release-deadline overstays, mostly charged to C.

predictions.note: A gains on-time deliveries and carries no penalties.

predictions.note: B voted yes on the previous step.

predictions.note: C's penalties rise and its on-time rate is already 1.00.

proposals.title: block_k 3 -> 2 (re-measured with sanction_total reported)
proposals.rationale: This is resubmitted, not repeated on the same grounds. Three things have changed: hold_limit is now 50 s, A has become the worst company at 0.91 with 938 blocked seconds, and sanction_total is now reported as K1 and R3 required. Earlier periods showed the largest customer gains from this change (+5.8 to +9.2 on-time, late down sharply). Under the current heavier load it should again raise on-time and A's rate. B and C are expected to vote no again, so it likely fails the vote. It is offered to confirm the gain across seeds with the costs fully reported, not as a referral for a quorum change.
